proofs.text: Run the server over an `initialize` request and verify every line of stdout parses as JSON, while stderr carries the text `Purlin MCP server`

reasons: PROOF-5 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: Stdout carries JSON-RPC responses and nothing else; the startup line naming the version and the root goes to stderr

tests.body:
def test_initialize_names_the_protocol_and_the_version(self, project):
        responses, stderr = _rpc(project.root, {
            'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'initialize',
            'params': {'protocolVersion': '2024-11-05', 'capabilities': {},
                       'clientInfo': {'name': 't', 'version': '0'}}},
            child=True)
        result = responses[0]['result']
        assert result['protocolVersion'] == '2024-11-05'
        assert result['serverInfo']['name'] == 'purlin'
        with open(os.path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'VERSION'),
                  encoding='utf-8') as handle:
            assert result['serverInfo']['version'] == handle.read().strip()
        assert 'Purlin MCP server' in stderr
